name: Stanford Hotel Myeongdong
nearestTransit: Seoul Metro Line 2 Euljiro 1(il)-ga Station Exit 5/6 (~2 min walk); Line 4 Myeongdong Station (~7 min walk); Airport Limousine Bus 6015 'Lotte Hotel / IBIS Myeong-dong' stop on same block
luggageNotes: Tell taxi drivers 'Stanford Hotel Myeongdong (Namdaemun-ro)' — do NOT confuse with Stanford Hotel Seoul in Sangam-dong (Mapo-gu).

name: L7 HAEUNDAE by LOTTE HOTELS
nearestTransit: Busan Metro Line 2 Haeundae Station Exit 5 (~4 min level walk down Gunam-ro); ~3–4 min walk to Haeundae Beach & SEA LIFE Aquarium
luggageNotes: Check-out is 11:00 AM (1 hour earlier than Seoul hotels). Exit 5 of Haeundae Station has nearby elevator access on Gunam-ro.

name: Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae
nearestTransit: Hongik Univ. Station (AREX All-Stop / Seoul Metro Line 2 / Gyeongui-Jungang Line) — Exit 9 (~2 min walk via stairs) or Exit 8 (~4–5 min walk with elevator)
luggageNotes: From AREX platforms at Hongik Univ. Station, follow underground transfer walkway (~5–6 min) to Line 2 Exit 8 (elevator) or Exit 9 (stairs). Hotel ground entrance is at the rear of the building behind the Yanghwa-ro retail storefronts.
